title: Normand Andy
body:
Description

Normand Andy is the cashier of Illumine Designs.

Appearance

They have the appearance of a stereotypical "nerd" person.

Dialogue

When you talk to him without any item in the counter, he will say:

  • "*snorts* WELL akshully, you have to put the stuff NEAR the counter for me to sell it to you."
    • Okay!" (Ends conversation)

When you talk to him with any item in the counter, he says:

  • "You really want (item name)? That costs a hefty (price), it's important to make smart economical decisions. *snickers*"
    • Absolutely! (Purchases item)
    • No thank you, I'm good. (Ends conversation)
